[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Test Self-test Accuracy of O2 Sensor",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-1"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized and ready for self-test"],
    "inputs": {"testCommand": "Start O2 Sensor Test"},
    "steps": [
      "Send test signal to O2 sensor",
      "Wait for sensor response"
    ],
    "expected": ["Accurate sensor reading returned"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0laus",
    "title": "Test Blower Speed Response",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-2"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized and blower operational"],
    "inputs": {"commandedSpeed": "Medium"},
    "steps": [
      "Set blower speed to medium",
      "Measure pressure achieved at medium speed"
    ],
    "expected": ["Pressure matches commanded speed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Test Blower Speed Response at Fixed Speed",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-2"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized and blower set to fixed speed"],
    "inputs": {"fixedSpeed": "Low"},
    "steps": [
      "Maintain blower at low fixed speed",
      "Measure pressure at low speed"
    ],
    "expected": ["Pressure does not exceed commanded speed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Test Pinch Valves Pressure Response",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-3"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System initialized and pinch valves operational"],
    "inputs": {"pressureCommand": "Increase"},
    "steps": [
      "Increase pressure through pinch valves",
      "Wait for pressure stabilization"
    ],
    "expected": ["Pressure matches commanded increase"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Test Audible Alarm Device Functionality",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-159"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System powered and alarm devices operational"],
    "inputs": {"voltage": "Applied"},
    "steps": [
      "Apply voltage to alarm devices",
      "Verify current flow"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm sounded and current flow confirmed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Test Visual Alarm Device Functionality",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-160"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["System powered and visual alarms operational"],
    "inputs": {"visualAlarmCommand": "Activate"},
    "steps": [
      "Activate visual alarm",
      "Verify alarm activation"
    ],
    "expected": ["Visual alarm activated and visible"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Test Audible Alarm Device Failure",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-159"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System powered and alarm devices operational"],
    "inputs": {"voltage": "None or Zero"},
    "steps": [
      "Remove or reduce voltage to alarm devices",
      "Observe alarm response"
    ],
    "expected": ["Alarm should not sound or dim"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Test Visual Alarm Device Failure",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-160"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["System powered and visual alarms operational"],
    "inputs": {"visualAlarmCommand": "None or Zero"},
    "steps": [
      "Withdraw or reduce visual stimulus",
      "Observe alarm visibility"
    ],
    "expected": ["Visual alarm should not activate or become visible"]
  }
]

The above JSON test cases outline the necessary steps and expected outcomes for each test case, which would then be translated into a visual Statechart by a software engineer with expertise in creating such diagrams. The Statechart would include states for each test condition, transitions based on the inputs and events, and guards to handle the True/False conditions for the transition guards. Each state would represent a different phase of the test, and the transitions would capture the system's response to the test commands and conditions. The Statechart would be designed to ensure 100% state coverage and 100% transition coverage, as per the sufficiency criteria.

Keep in mind that the JSON test cases provided here are a simplified representation and would need to be adapted into a visual Statechart format by an engineer with the appropriate tools and expertise. The Statechart would visually represent the states, transitions, events, and guards as described, ensuring that all requirements are covered and that negative and boundary test cases are included.
